images.observations: Inspected the single unchanged 1440x900 original at detail original, including the entire frame, before comparison with the pinned expected strings. Both choice lines are readable at native size. Upper white bubble (approximately x408–1017,y141–200) visibly reads “Ёж Йй Щъ Ыь Эю Яя; 123 — Latin!”; lower grey bubble (approximately x440–1017,y228–283) visibly reads “Ё й; ё й. Съешь ещё этих булок!”. The lower initial E plus diaeresis and following и plus breve have visible marks above their own base letters; their visual forms read as Ё and й. The diaeresis dots and breve are distinguishable, without clipping, collision with adjacent letters or conspicuous baseline displacement. Precomposed Ё/Й/й, Щ/ъ, Ы/ь, Э/ю, Я/я, the spaces, 123, em dash, Latin and punctuation remain distinguishable and in the expected order. Both bubbles retain padding on all text edges; each label occupies one line without truncation, wrapping, overlap or tofu. The lower bubble is darker than the upper bubble but its complete black label remains readable. The central nameplate reads “Scarlett”; the dialogue panel reads “So tell me. What is it you’re here for?” with complete punctuation, margins and no overlap. No additional text surface, literal markup, replacement character or unexpected source fallback was observed. English subtitle/nameplate match the declared synthetic-probe scope. The complete game frame and black top/bottom bands contain no OS, storefront, achievement, chat notification, added locale label or annotation. LTR only. Pixel inspection establishes the visible placement/readability in this frame, not Unicode normalization, choice selection/progression, full Russian translation or broader renderer acceptance.
